Sailors and marine oilers (O*NET 53-5011.00) cover ordinary and able seamen and engine room assistants: keeping lookout, taking soundings, steering to orders, handling lines and cargo gear, and maintaining the hull, or lubricating machinery, watching pressure and temperature, and recording. subject.summary: Sailors and marine oilers carry out lookout watches, mooring, cargo gear, and hull maintenance, or engine room lubrication, gauge checks, and log keeping, under the direction of the captain, deck officers, or engineers; deck and engine room duties, certificates, and emergency authority are verified separately.
